title: Source surface to candidate primitive
purpose: Convert each declared candidate primitive on a source surface into a normalized candidate object that can be searched, reviewed, compared, and promoted.
privacy_rule: Use synthetic/public source-surface metadata only; private manuals and real PII stay tenant-bound.

title: Source surface entity links
purpose: Link generated primitive objects to verticals, workflows, primitive types, source-surface input types, output object types, and required stages.
privacy_rule: Entity refs use canonical/generated IDs rather than raw private source mentions.

title: Source surface embedding stub
purpose: Emit deterministic embedding text and buckets for source-surface-derived primitives before real embedding backfill.
privacy_rule: Embedding text is derived from synthetic source-surface metadata only.

title: Source surface review routing
purpose: Open review tickets for high-risk generated primitives before they become deployable tools, pipelines, or knowledge packs.
privacy_rule: Review reasons should describe synthetic risk, not expose private source material.
